rows.name: isolated ordinary menu and same XComponent owner
first explicit entry requests one empty run
DOWN/MOVE/UP routes both source kinds on one run
background cancels old callback and resume requires new DOWN
manual and sensor paths are mutually exclusive
V2 rejects or cold-selects with no optimistic label
native resource fault preserves reason and blocks DOWN
hide/show closes and renews page session without resetting run
